sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "riskmanagement"."flowlink" AS e, SUM("riskmanagement"."breachcount") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("riskmanagement"."compscore" - "riskmanagement"."riskassess") AS REAL) / "riskmanagement"."riskassess")) AS m2 FROM "riskmanagement" GROUP BY "riskmanagement"."flowlink"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: riskmanagement.relative difference of compliance posture score from risk score
why: total of data breaches per dataflow (by flowlink) (additive)
(compliance posture score - risk score) / risk score: the relative difference of two quantities in points
average of relative difference of compliance posture score from risk score per dataflow (by flowlink)
gap to the all average of average of relative difference of compliance posture score from risk score (all level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "riskmanagement"."flowlink" AS e, "dataflow"."chanproto" AS g, AVG("riskmanagement"."incidentcount") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("riskmanagement"."compscore" - "riskmanagement"."riskassess") AS REAL) / "riskmanagement"."riskassess")) AS m2 FROM "riskmanagement" JOIN "dataflow" ON "dataflow"."recordregistry" = "riskmanagement"."flowlink"  GROUP BY "riskmanagement"."flowlink", "dataflow"."chanproto"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g" ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: riskmanagement.relative difference of compliance posture score from risk score
why: average of incidents per dataflow within dataflow.chanproto
(compliance posture score - risk score) / risk score: the relative difference of two quantities in points
average of relative difference of compliance posture score from risk score per dataflow within dataflow.chanproto
gap to the g average of average of relative difference of compliance posture score from risk score (g level)
